summary: Home Manager configuration now uses services.fractal instead of services.smalltalk, without a compatibility alias.

replay.detail: No durable state or replay change. The existing host migration still owns directory moves and receipts.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule change.

compatibility.detail: All public Home Manager options move to services.fractal. services.smalltalk assignments are no longer accepted. Legacy service names in legacy/stage phases and the existing completed-phase receipt, directory, config-fence and service guards are unchanged. macOS target labels remain com.compoundingtech.fractal and com.compoundingtech.fractal-apply; Linux target units remain fractal.service and fractal-apply.service.

downtime.detail: The option namespace rename adds no restart or cutover. Existing Home Manager activation and explicit host migration behavior are unchanged.

manual.detail: Rename every services.smalltalk option assignment to services.fractal when upgrading the module, preserving its values and fractalMigration.phase. Do not select completed merely to rename options: populated installations must still stage, run fractal migrate host successfully, retain its receipts, then activate completed. See docs/site/reference/home-manager.md and docs/site/guides/upgrading.md. Focused regression: nix build .#checks.x86_64-linux.hm-module-fractal-prestage-eval --no-link --print-build-logs.

recovery.detail: When reverting to a module revision with the old namespace, restore services.smalltalk option assignments. This does not roll back host migration; retain the existing phase and follow the host cutover recovery procedure for state or service rollback.
